name: Semantic Uncoupling via Inclusion-Exclusion Disguise
description: Replaces the arbitrary arithmetic equation (which models easily simplify algebraically to discover the independent set penalty) with a natural set-theoretic equivalence (sum of sizes equals size of union) grounded in a data deduplication scenario. This forces the model to recognize that equality only holds when the sets are pairwise disjoint, which translates back to the independent set condition, without providing any algebraic formula to parse.
